title: Gouache Seascape by Trost Richards
content: William Trost Richards, Rocky Coastline, gouache, 1878, 29½ by 43¼In this large gouache painting by Trost Richards, the sun is centered in the composition.The sunlight is echoed in the reflections, which are tucked in the small space between the rocks directly below the sky, and there are even smaller dots of light on the wet pebbles below that.Auction result of Trost Richards painting "Rocky Coastline"
